** Modified skin:**
Arcane Brawler Vi

Since I wasnt happy with how the Arcane Brawler Legendary skin for Vi looked, I decided to make a custom skin to make her look closer ot her acual appearance in Arcane Season 2.
I mostly used the preview model of Arcane Chainbreaker Vi in Wild Rift and modified a lot of it to work with the rig of Arcane Brawler.
